title: Allowing a Client Credit for Kiosk Outage against a Micro Market Settlement Invoice
content:
A client of the Unattended Micro Market Program whose kiosk could not take a payment is allowed a credit against the micro market settlement invoice for the period. The credit is set against the named invoice, carries the settlement period it relates to, and names the kiosk whose lost hours it answers; the client's unsettled balance falls by it.

## A condition on the period's figure

The credit allowed for a settlement period is fixed only after the product settlement for that period stands charged on the agreement. Until that period's product settlement stands charged on the agreement, the credit for it is not yet fixed.

## Allowing the credit

The tool `issue_market_outage_credit_49294a76` allows the credit. It is an agent-side tool: the desk unlocks it and then calls it, one call adding a single service credit posting to the agreement's ledger against the named invoice.

### Parameters

- `market_agreement_id` — the reference number identifying the micro market agreement being credited, as returned by the micro market agreement lookup.
- `invoice_reference` — the settlement invoice the credit is set against, written as INV-MK- followed by 6 digits exactly as it is printed on the invoice. An empty value is not accepted.
- `service_period` — the settlement period the credit relates to, written as YYYY-MM with no other text. An empty value is not accepted.
- `credit_amount_usd` — the credit to allow, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent at the point of booking, a figure falling exactly on the half-cent going to the nearest even cent. A negative value is not accepted.

### Return

A single confirmation sentence in plain text, carrying the reference number minted for the new credit posting, the invoice it was set against, and the amount allowed in USD to two decimal places. Receiving that sentence means the credit stands against the invoice; no other outcome is reported.

## The effect on the client's account

Afterwards the client sees the credit sitting against that invoice and owes that much less on it.
